name: Shama
overview: Shama is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Hotham the Aroerite. Beyond this unique attribute, there is no additional information about his tribe or other personal details. His mention is brief and specific to his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Shama is a proper name meaning 'one obedient [to y-h-v-h]'. This meaning highlights a character of obedience to the Lord, though the name was not given directly by God. The name appears in 1 Chronicles 11:44.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Shama is the son of Hotham. No other family relationships are documented in the biblical text for Shama beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Shama's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his identification as a descendant of Hotham the Aroerite. His mention helps to preserve the genealogical and tribal records important to the historical context of Israel. Though brief, his inclusion in 1 Chronicles 11:44 reflects the careful recording of God's people and their heritage.
